findings.summary: [Auth relies on x-user-id header and falls back to mock user] Auth currently trusts 'x-user-id' from headers without verification, and falls back to a hardcoded mock user id.
[TOEIC Router not mounted in Express app] The Express server.ts only defines /api/health and does not import or mount the toeicRouter from routes/toeic.routes.ts.
[Stale revision updates return success] When a client sends a stale revision to updateResponse, the server query skips the update but still returns success without warning the client.

[Submit and grading jobs lack database transactions] The submitAttempt method performs updates and enqueues grading jobs using independent queries without a database transaction, exposing the system to partial success failures.

[Missing validation for question/option belonging to the exam of the attempt] The updateResponse service does not verify that the questionId and selectedOptionId actually belong to the exam of the attempt.
[Catalog API does not support search, filter, or pagination] The getExams backend service queries the entire database table without applying filters, search queries, or pagination limit/offset.

[Npm test reports fake green status] The test scripts in the root and workspace package.json files are configured to echo 'No tests configured yet' and exit 0, ignoring the actual Jest test files in src/tests.
[Backend lint errors] The backend project has lint errors or is missing structured lint configurations in place.
[Migration test does not run against a real MySQL database] The migrations.test.ts file mocks the db.service pool, so migrations are never tested against a real MySQL instance.
[Incomplete environment validation and CORS allowlist configuration] Environment variables are not fully validated at startup, and CORS allowlist rules are not fully populated or enforced in Express.
